observation.visible_scene: Close-up of a pottery wheel holding a partially thrown reddish-brown clay vessel with a cylindrical foot, a bulged shoulder, and an open mouth. A pink caliper-style tool is held against the upper-right side of the vessel, its handle extending off the right edge. A seated potter in a gray shirt and green pants appears blurred in the background with wet hands. The wheel head shows rotational motion blur throughout.
visible_changes: From t=0.0 to t=0.96 the background hands hover and shift slightly above/behind the vessel without clear contact, while the caliper stays in contact with the vessel's shoulder and the wheel spins.
From t=1.04 to t=1.76 an arm and hand sweep across the front of the vessel from the left, occluding the clay body as it passes, then withdraw toward the lower right.

From t=1.84 to t=3.2 a hand holding a green sponge appears at the left and presses the sponge against the base/foot of the vessel on the wheel head, wiping that area; the sponge remains there through the end.
The caliper's contact point on the right shoulder and the overall vessel silhouette remain essentially unchanged across the whole excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: What was done to the vessel before this segment and the final form after it are not shown.
Whether the sweeping hand actually touched the clay or only passed in front of it cannot be confirmed from the blur.
uncertain_details: The exact motion (cleaning vs. shaping) of the sponge at the base is not determinable.
The identity of the pink tool and the green object is inferred from appearance only.
Camera movement is minimal and indistinct; background blur is likely depth of field rather than motion.
